title: VIP private sale access
description: Give VIP customers early access to a private sale with an exclusive code. Promotion WhatsApp template for retail loyalty members.
notes: Exclusivity wording is fine when true; make sure the segment really is VIP-only. Include the offer end date.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, as a valued {{tier}} member you get first access to our private sale. Take *{{percent}}% off* before it opens to everyone on {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
